description: Updates an existing program. Use when the user wants to set duration, workouts per week, or edit program metadata. Fields you leave out keep their stored values, including goals and the workout schedule.

description.description: New program description. Omit to keep it.

duration_in_weeks.description: New program length in weeks, 1 to 52.

goal_ids.description: 1 or 2 program goal IDs from list_team_goals. Omit to keep the current goals.

name.description: New program name. Omit to keep the current one.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

visibility.description: Who sees it: "public" shows it to members and in public lists; "private" keeps it to the team.

workout_ids.description: Ordered workout IDs from list_team_workouts, at least 2. Repeat an ID to schedule it again. Replaces the schedule. Omit to keep it.

name: update_program
title: Update program
